'''Krupp''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who fought in the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]] during the [[Galactic War]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] aboard the [[Kuat Defensive Station]].<ref name="TOR" />
